create_struct_of_array_dataclass: create a frozen dataclass decorated with StructOfArray to represent nested struct of arrays with JAX pytree support
implement_getitem_indexing: implement indexing on a StructOfArray instance to slice all array fields uniformly using get_item
validate_shapes_and_dtypes: validate that all array fields in a StructOfArray instance have matching shapes and dtypes via post_init
flatten_pytree_node: flatten a StructOfArray instance into flat arrays and metadata for JAX tree traversal using flatten
query_shape_and_dtype: query the shape and dtype properties of a StructOfArray instance to inspect its array dimensions and data type
